hypothesis: Prior completed-match game share adds match-winner predictive information beyond a fitted binary-result Elo backbone.
scope: Frozen Jeff Sackmann ATP/WTA main-tour 2020-2025; raw source identities, no history ordinal joins; no 2026 or live forecast holdout reads.
availability: All source results become available strictly AFTER tournament_start +21 calendar days. Same rule for all arms. Synthetic conservative reconstruction, NOT verified historical observation timestamps.
features: Binary and game-share Elo: identical decayed K=120/(n+5)^0.4, 1500 initialization, same pre-update expectations, surface initialized from overall, logit mix 0.65 surface +0.35 overall. Binary target=win; game target=observed fraction of completed games won. No odds/ranks/current-game scores enter prediction. No intercept to preserve player-swap symmetry.
fitting: Expanding chronological logistic regression, ridge coefficient penalty 1.0, no hyperparameter search; training starts 2021, only labels with tournament_start+21d strictly before fold start; raw feature units fixed, no full-corpus scaling. Fit one pooled ATP/WTA model per arm.
confirmation_caveat: 2025 outcomes have featured in earlier Elo research; NOT a fresh or untouched holdout. Candidate definition frozen before reading this experiment's outcomes.
decision: Research advance only if candidate log loss and Brier improve vs BOTH baseline and fitted control in all 5 dev folds; then freeze coefficients trained before confirmation and open confirmation once. Confirmation paired CI must exclude zero for both metrics vs control, ATP/WTA each nonworsening point estimates. Otherwise REJECT/NEEDS MORE TESTING. No promotion: no verified historical executable odds or fresh forward holdout.
report: no profitability claim without price evidence
stop: Do not add variants, change windows, rescue thresholds, or open confirmation on failed development. A failure is recorded and model code stays off main.
